newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA in talks for aircraft repair venture.
newsitem.headline: SIA in talks for aircraft repair venture.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) said on Friday its wholly owned subsidiary SIA Engineering Co Pte Ltd was in joint venture negotiations with a third party for the overhaul and repair of commercial aircraft engines.
If the negotiations proved successful, part of SIA Engineering's existing engine overhaul facility would be merged with the joint venture facility, it said in a statement.
SIA, together with SIA Engineering would be an equity partner in the joint venture facility. It did not identify the third party.
